verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an observability and incident-management platform, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only Better Stack's hosted SaaS. Custom-subdomain status pages via a CNAME record are hosted branding, not self-hosting, so they earn no credit. Nothing documents a deployable or on-prem version of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
